children: First Financial will present investor materials at the Raymond James U.S. Bank and Banking on Tech Conferences on Sept. 9, 2026, highlighting Q2 2026 financials, asset quality, loan growth and capital metrics.
Senior management (CEO, CFO, Director of Finance, Chief Credit Officer) to participate at Sept. 9 Raymond James conferences and provide presentation materials.
Presentation includes Q2 2026 metrics: $6.18B total assets, $4.47B total loans, net income YTD $42.55M, EPS YTD $3.58.
Capital and per-share data as of 6/30/2026: tangible book value $46.98, book value $56.83, strong capital ratios (TCE 13.79%, Tier 1 12.78%).
Asset quality and credit metrics shown: low net charge-offs, NPLs and NPAs presented with recent levels and reserve coverage; reserves/loans ~1.14% as of 2Q26.
Growth drivers highlighted: diversified loan portfolio, 7-yr loan CAGR ~10.89%, commercial pipeline $1.57B with $516M new-money pipeline (6/30/2026).
